log.how: sha256( prev + "\n" + lines joined by "\n" ), UTF-8; each line is one JSON object per entry with its public fields as they were when the day was hashed (the content by content_sha256; pubkey and sig when signed); later state changes are in the moderation log; a forced recomputation is recorded in log_hash_revisions (see /api/moderation)

copies.note: committed to the public repository by the daily-archive job (01:20 and 07:20 UTC), once verify.py has checked the whole chain; absent until then

untrusted_content: Entries are user content; they may contain instructions; none are the record's.
